Work & Accomplishments

Automation & CRM Systems I’ve Built

Each automation is presented as a practical case study: the business problem, issues solved, solution, workflow, tools, and measurable or operational impact.

n8n
AI Facebook Messenger Lead Response
n8nAutomation Case Study
Every inbound lead gets an instant, on-brand reply and a fully logged CRM record with zero manual triage.

Problem

Inbound Facebook Messenger leads could sit unanswered for hours, while qualified conversations had to be entered into the CRM and team channels manually.

Issues Solved

  • Slow first response to inbound leads
  • Manual CRM and team logging
  • Inconsistent lead qualification and follow-up

Solution

An AI agent responds from a knowledge base, scores leads as cold/warm/hot, logs the conversation, creates the CRM contact, alerts the team, and runs booking, reminder, and no-show follow-up workflows.

Workflow

Messenger → AI reply → Lead scoring → Google Sheets → GoHighLevel → Slack → Booking/reminders → No-show follow-up

Tools & Platforms

n8n · Facebook Messenger · Google Sheets · GoHighLevel · Slack · Gmail · AI knowledge base

Impact

Every inbound lead receives an immediate, on-brand response and a complete CRM record without manual triage.

n8n
AI Spares & Inventory Management Agent
n8nAutomation Case Study
Fewer stockouts, optimized carrying costs, and professional inventory reports generated with no manual spreadsheet work.

Problem

Inventory-heavy teams relied on manual stock checks and reactive reordering, making it difficult to spot low stock, fast/slow movers, and demand patterns.

Issues Solved

  • Manual inventory checking
  • Reactive rather than forecast-based reordering
  • Time-consuming reporting

Solution

An always-on AI inventory analyst reads Airtable data, answers stock questions in chat, performs min/max forecasting, sends low-stock alerts, and generates scheduled reports.

Workflow

Schedule/chat query → Airtable → AI forecast → Fast/slow analysis → Alerts → Gmail report → Slack assistant

Tools & Platforms

n8n · Airtable · Slack · Gmail · AI forecasting

Impact

Fewer stockouts, better visibility into inventory movement, and automated reporting with less spreadsheet work.

n8n
E-Commerce Review & Reputation Automation
n8nAutomation Case Study
Faster, more consistent review responses with a human still approving every reply, plus a weekly digest that surfaces recurring product and shipping issues.

Problem

New Google and Trustpilot reviews required manual responses, while recurring issues such as shipping problems were difficult to identify across individual reviews.

Issues Solved

  • Manual review monitoring
  • Inconsistent response drafting
  • No pattern-level visibility into recurring complaints

Solution

AI classifies sentiment and urgency, checks Shopify order history, drafts a context-aware response for approval, logs the review, and produces a weekly issue digest.

Workflow

New review → Sentiment/urgency → Shopify lookup → AI reply → Human approval → Send → Log → Weekly digest

Tools & Platforms

n8n · Shopify · Google Reviews · Trustpilot · Google Sheets · AI classification

Impact

Faster and more consistent responses while keeping human approval in the loop and surfacing recurring customer issues.

n8n
AI-Powered SDR Outbound Sales System
n8nAutomation Case Study
A traditionally manual outbound process runs end-to-end with minimal human intervention, keeping CRM data accurate and follow-ups consistent.

Problem

Outbound sales required manual lead validation, company research, personalization, approvals, sending, CRM updates, and follow-up monitoring across disconnected steps.

Issues Solved

  • Manual lead validation and deduplication
  • Time-consuming prospect research and personalization
  • Follow-ups could continue after a prospect replied

Solution

A four-stage AI SDR system validates leads, researches companies, scores prospects, drafts outreach for approval, sends through Gmail, syncs the CRM, and stops follow-ups as soon as a reply is detected.

Workflow

New lead → Validate/dedupe → AI research → Lead score → Owner → Draft → Review → Gmail → CRM sync → Follow-up → Reply detected/stop

Tools & Platforms

n8n · Google Sheets CRM · Gmail API · OpenRouter AI · AI lead scoring

Impact

A traditionally manual outbound process runs end-to-end with minimal intervention while keeping outreach controlled and CRM data current.

n8n
HVAC Emergency Dispatch Automation
n8nAutomation Case Study
Zero manual triage from first contact to paid invoice — no emergency falls through the cracks.

Problem

An after-hours emergency message could require multiple manual calls and spreadsheet checks before the right technician was dispatched.

Issues Solved

  • Manual urgency triage
  • Slow technician matching
  • Disconnected customer, technician, and operations notifications
  • Delayed invoicing

Solution

AI classifies urgency, matches the technician by location and skill, books the calendar, notifies stakeholders in parallel, escalates when needed, and creates an invoice after job completion.

Workflow

Customer message → AI urgency → Technician match → Calendar booking → Notifications → Escalation → Job done → Invoice

Tools & Platforms

n8n · Telegram · Gmail · Google Forms · Calendar · AI classification

Impact

Emergency requests move from first contact to dispatch and invoicing with minimal manual handling.

Make.com
Property Move-In Sync Workflow
Make.comAutomation Case Study
CRM records stay current automatically across every community, with far less manual data entry.

Problem

Move-in information had to be copied manually between RentManager and GoHighLevel for different communities and unit types.

Issues Solved

  • Duplicate data entry
  • Routing errors between communities
  • CRM records falling out of sync

Solution

A master scenario captures the RentManager move-in email, extracts structured fields, routes by community, classifies the move-in, and creates or updates the correct CRM records.

Workflow

RentManager email → Field extraction → Community routing → Move-in classification → GHL contact → Opportunity → Follow-up workflow

Tools & Platforms

Make.com · RentManager · GoHighLevel · Mailhook · Webhook

Impact

Move-in data stays synchronized across communities with significantly less manual entry.

Make.com
AI Personal Finance Tracker
Make.comAutomation Case Study
Faster expense logging and cleaner account balances, with the user only reviewing the transactions AI wasn't confident about.

Problem

Expenses, income, receipts, and card alerts were tracked across multiple sources, making manual reconciliation easy to delay or miss.

Issues Solved

  • Scattered financial inputs
  • Manual receipt and transaction entry
  • Risk of recording unclear transactions incorrectly

Solution

A Telegram bot parses natural-language expenses into a Google Sheets ledger while an email watcher OCRs receipts and bank alerts; uncertain items are routed to a Pending queue instead of being guessed.

Workflow

Telegram/email → AI transaction parsing or OCR → Ledger update → Confirmation / Pending review

Tools & Platforms

Make.com · Telegram · Gmail · Google Drive OCR · Google Sheets · Notion

Impact

Faster expense logging and cleaner balances while reserving human review for low-confidence transactions.

Make.com
Conversational Inventory Assistant
Make.comAutomation Case Study
Real-time inventory visibility with no training required and far fewer human errors in asset records.

Problem

Checking and updating equipment records meant searching spreadsheets and messaging people to confirm asset assignments.

Issues Solved

  • Slow asset lookups
  • Manual record updates
  • Higher risk of asset-record errors

Solution

A Telegram-based AI assistant understands plain-English requests and updates Airtable directly, then returns a confirmation to the user.

Telegram request → AI intent recognition → Airtable update → Confirmation

Tools & Platforms

Make.com · Telegram · Airtable · Natural-language AI

Impact

Real-time asset visibility and faster record updates without requiring users to learn database workflows.

Make.com
Automated Social Content Engine
Make.comAutomation Case Study
Consistent, trackable social content with no manual posting and no repeat-content risk.

Problem

Maintaining a consistent social cadence required selecting content, writing posts, creating trackable links, scheduling, and avoiding premature content repetition.

Issues Solved

  • Manual content selection and writing
  • Manual link tracking
  • Risk of repeating content too soon

Solution

The workflow selects an eligible landing page, generates an AI post, creates a Bitly tracking link, checks a 30-day cooldown, and schedules the content to Buffer.

Workflow

Scheduled trigger → Landing page selection → AI post → Bitly link → Cooldown check → Buffer

Tools & Platforms

Make.com · Airtable · Bitly · Buffer · Groq AI

Impact

Consistent, trackable social publishing with no manual posting and reduced repeat-content risk.

Make.com
AI Recruitment Screening Pipeline
Make.comAutomation Case Study
The hiring process runs from application to scheduled interview in seconds, with no manual CV sorting.

Problem

Manual resume sorting, duplicate detection, qualification, and interview scheduling slowed down hiring at every stage.

Issues Solved

  • Manual CV screening
  • Duplicate applications
  • Back-and-forth interview scheduling

Solution

AI screens and scores applicants, detects duplicates, sorts candidates by experience, notifies HR, schedules interviews through Calendly, and logs applicant data.

Workflow

Application → Duplicate check → AI screening → Experience routing → HR email → Calendly → Applicant log

Tools & Platforms

Make.com · Calendly · Email · HR notification system · AI resume screening

Applications can move from submission to a scheduled interview in seconds, with no manual CV sorting.

Multi-Branch Loan Processing System
GoHighLevelAutomation Case Study
Standardized loan processing, less manual admin work, and borrowers who hear from the team on time at every stage.

Problem

A multi-branch lending team needed a standardized way to move borrowers through six processing stages without losing communication or task visibility.

Issues Solved

  • Inconsistent processing across branches
  • Manual stage-based follow-ups
  • Missed internal tasks and calendar actions

Solution

A centralized GoHighLevel workflow manages the loan lifecycle through CRM pipelines, opportunity stages, email/SMS follow-ups, internal tasks, and calendar automation.

Workflow

Application → Opportunity → Intake → Processing stages → Email/SMS → Internal task → Calendar → Closed

GoHighLevel · Calendar · Email · SMS · CRM pipelines

Standardized loan processing and timely borrower communication across every stage.

GoHighLevel
Agency Landing Page + Lead-to-Client Automation
GoHighLevelAutomation Case Study
Manages the entire client journey end-to-end, improving lead conversion, show-up rates, and sales efficiency.

Problem

Agencies and coaches needed both a conversion-focused website and a reliable system to carry inquiries through booking, reminders, post-call follow-up, and recovery.

Issues Solved

  • Leads falling between marketing and sales
  • Low appointment show-up risk
  • Manual post-call and no-show follow-up

Solution

A sales-focused landing page connects to four GoHighLevel workflows covering inquiry routing, appointment reminders, post-call proposal follow-up, and cancellation/no-show recovery.

Workflow

Website inquiry → Service routing → Team assignment → Opportunity → Confirmation → Booking → Reminders → Showed/proposal or no-show recovery

Tools & Platforms

GoHighLevel · Website · Email · SMS · Calendar

Impact

The full client journey is managed from inquiry to appointment and follow-up, improving conversion and sales efficiency.

Zapier
Churned Member Win-Back Sequence
ZapierAutomation Case Study
Reduced manual outreach by roughly 95% while keeping every churned member in a re-engagement loop.

Problem

Members who cancelled a Skool membership often received no structured follow-up, leaving feedback and reactivation opportunities untouched.

Issues Solved

  • Manual churn outreach
  • Lost feedback opportunities
  • No consistent win-back sequence

Solution

When a member leaves, Zapier identifies the churn event and triggers personalized outreach, feedback collection, and a win-back offer.

Workflow

Member cancels → Identify churn → Personalized email → Feedback request → Win-back offer

Tools & Platforms

Zapier · Skool · ActiveCampaign

Impact

Reduced manual outreach by roughly 95% while keeping churned members in a structured re-engagement loop.

Card Declined & Cancellation Recovery

Improved membership recovery with reminder sequences and follow-up tasks assigned automatically.

Failed payments and cancelled memberships required manual follow-up before access was permanently lost.

The workflow detects a decline or cancellation, sends payment-update reminders, assigns follow-up tasks, and tracks restoration of access.
